basic_info.description: Nestled within the historic Presidio Gardens and adjacent to the Presidio Terrace residential enclave is a large three bedroom, two and one-half bath, two-story townhome with private entrance and a two-car private garage. This townhome was extensively remodeled in 2011 and features refinished hardwood floors throughout, French casement windows, original custom moldings, new electrical and plumbing, and many other upgrades.The first floor consists of a state-of-the-art kitchen with Viking gas range and oven, Miele dishwasher, built-in wine cooler, new high-end custom cabinetry (2011) throughout and granite countertops with eat-in serving bar. The spacious open plan dining room and living room includes built-in bookshelves, recessed TV alcove with hard-wired HDMI, and a Valor automatic gas fireplace with granite surround and hearth. A half bath resides off the living room hallway.The second floor features three bedrooms including a large master with custom wardrobe unit, a second equally large master with en-suite bath, and a third room perfect for use as bedroom or office. The second level main atrium hallway leads to a spacious bathroom with custom shower and two pedestal sinks.The private two-car tandem garage at street level is large enough for additional storage or workshop. A second storage room is located below the townhome and accessed by private rear entrance.Please visit: www.PresidioGardens.com
